---
title: "Env.GetInt"
description: "Get an int value by key from the Env store."
---

Get the `int` value associated with `key`. Returns `0` if the key is absent, or if the key holds a different kind (Bool or FloatBits or String): there is no cross-kind coercion.

## Signature

```enforce
static proto native int GetInt(string key);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| key | `string` | The key to read. |

## Returns

The stored `int`, or `0` if the key is absent or holds a non-Int kind.

## Behavior

Reads are serialized against writers: the store is locked. The kind check is strict: a key whose value was written with [Env.SetBool](./setbool), [Env.SetFloatBits](./setfloatbits), or [Env.SetString](./setstring) returns `0` here. Use [Env.Has](./has) to ask whether a key exists at all, regardless of kind.

## Edge cases

- Missing keys return `0`, indistinguishable from a legitimately stored `0`.
- A `key` whose value was set by [Env.SetBool](./setbool) returns `0`: Bool and Int are separate kinds even though both surface as `int` in script.
- A `key` whose value was set by [Env.SetString](./setstring) returns `0`.

## Example

```enforce
Env.SetInt("counter", 42);
int n = Env.GetInt("counter"); // 42
```
